column4: A hard heavy blow landing on a human body, a dull flesh and bone thud, very close, dry, no voice
A sharp wet impact of something striking a person's shoulder, cloth and flesh, very close, no voice
A brutal crunching hit to a body, a deep thump with a wet crack, very close, no voice
A heavy slow human heartbeat heard from inside your own head, deep muffled thumps, steady, no music
A few heavy drops of blood dripping onto dry leaves, very close, quiet
Wet raw flesh tearing open, skin and muscle ripping with a sticky squelch, very close, horror, no voice
A wet meaty slice and tear, flesh pulled apart, blood spattering, very close, horror, no voice
A bone cracking and snapping inside a body, a sharp dry crunch muffled by flesh, very close, horror, no voice
A thick splash of blood and gore slapping onto glass, wet and heavy, very close, no voice
Slow footsteps in boots soaked through with blood, each step a wet squelch, close, no voice
A swarm of fat flies buzzing close around the listener's head, now near the ear, now away, no other sounds
